name: The Prank 2
source:
[i]The Prank 2[/i] follows 3 guys (Tikus, Chuma and BIlly) as they are called to ”The Pit”, the one room in the school where everyone goes to await punishment.  While there, the three of them meet Teach, an uptight teacher, who accuses each of them of pulling a dirty prank. The real question is, who did it? Why did they do it? And what will Teach do to find out?

[Edited from [url=https://pelted-pixel-games.itch.io/the-prank-2]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[i]恶作剧2[/i] 讲述了3个家伙（Tikus、Chuma和BIlly）被叫到“坑”的故事，这是学校里每个人都去等待惩罚的房间。在那里，他们三人遇到了一位紧张的老师蒂奇，蒂奇指责他们每个人都在搞肮脏的恶作剧。真正的问题是，是谁干的？他们为什么这么做？为了找出答案，蒂奇将采取什么行动？

[编辑自[url=https://pelted-pixel-games.itch.io/the-prank-2]itch.io[/url]]
